name: Chocolate Buttercream Frosting
rw:note: NOT a variant of the vanilla buttercream. Every quantity differs and the method differs: sugar and cocoa go in in two lots rather than three, and milk is a required 1/4 cup rather than an optional thinner. A patch expressing this would be larger than the recipe it patched. Sibling in family:buttercream instead.
rw:coverageNote: The source states no coverage at all — only '12 servings', which is not a meaningful unit for frosting. No rw:covers block is asserted, so asking this recipe to frost a specific cake fails loudly rather than guessing. That is the correct behaviour: inventing a coverage figure here would be a fabrication.
recipeIngredient: 2.5 cups soft icing sugar/powdered sugar, sifted
1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa powder (preferably Dutch Processed), sifted

rw:ingredients.rw:note: Both source columns are recorded deliberately. The metric column says 200 g; 3/4 AU cup of butter is ~171 g. The importer must not silently pick one — the divergence check reports it.

rw:ingredients.rw:originalText: 2.5 cups soft icing sugar/powdered sugar, sifted
rw:ingredients.rw:note: The source's 'metric' column repeats the cup measure unconverted, so there is no gram figure to trust here.

rw:ingredients.rw:originalText: 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa powder (preferably Dutch Processed), sifted

rw:ingredients.rw:note: Structural here, unlike the vanilla recipe where milk is a conditional thinner. This is one of the reasons the two are siblings rather than variants.

recipeInstructions.text: Place butter in stand mixer bowl with paddle attached. Beat 3 minutes on speed 7 until pale.
Add half the icing sugar and cocoa powder. Beat 3 minutes, starting slow, increasing to speed 7.
Add remaining icing sugar and cocoa powder. Beat 3 minutes.
recipeInstructions.rw:portionNote: Found by the reverse linkage check, in a file written after the gap was already identified: the sugar and cocoa really are consumed here, as the remaining portion, and before rw:portion existed there was no way to say so.

recipeInstructions.text: Add milk and vanilla. Beat 1 minute on speed 7.
Spread onto cakes/cupcakes or pipe from frosting bag.

rw:notes: Beat for at least 6 minutes total, usually 7 to 8, for optimal fluffiness.
Use soft icing sugar, not pure icing sugar.
Dutch-processed cocoa gives a more intense flavour than natural cocoa.
